1. Choose up to four app shortcuts and save them. Add widgets and finish their setup if you want widget content too.

2. In Settings → Cover screen → Widgets, enable FlipLauncher. The setup checklist detects a FlipLauncher widget instance; confirm its cover placement in Settings.

3. Fold the phone and swipe to FlipLauncher. Your app shortcuts appear above the widgets. Cover updates start on their own when you have widgets; allow unrestricted battery use when asked so they keep running.

Tap a widget card or Open app to launch its app.

If One UI blocks or redirects a launch, review Good Lock → MultiStar → I ♡ Galaxy Foldable → Launcher Widget and the allowed apps. For full controls, also enable FlipLauncher there.
